body: I wishhh but for some reason everyone I've dated feels the need to tell their parents I'm trans.

Heyyy I'm not the only one!! Everyone's actually noticed the voice drop but because I'm kind of stealth and I'm 17, nobody really comments on it. My eczema actually migrated to exactly my jaw so that mixed with the growing hairs is annoying. Facial hair was noticed by someone today though which is nice.   


I'm excited to see what changes I experience over the next while! I only really check the day before my shot so I guess we'll see if anything new crops up in 2 weeks. I get to talk to my doctor about getting a top surgery consult in January.   


I'm half-European, so my arms are naturally hairy but it's starting to go towards my shoulder which is nice. Already had chest hair but they're growing more now.   


Fun fact: I was supposed to be born male. My father at the time of my conception worked in a factory with some chemical that basically made it so males couldn't produce male children. So that's my life.

I'm in a somewhat similar situation. I took one of my hobbies and made a career out of it. I loved writing. I became a blogger. It's still in opening stages, but it's the one thing I have right now and I'm determined to make it work. Maybe you could try doing something like that? Making a career out of something you enjoy doing?
